quests.firstStep: Convince Atar to leave Sanuarach Mine

takesYou.why: Atar and the Silver-Blood mercenaries hold the mine
Ainethach, who owns the mine: outside in Karthwasten from 7 am to 7 pm, in Karthwasten Hall at night

choices.choice: Side with the miners: get Atar and his mercenaries out of the mine
choices.leadsTo: tell Ainethach that Atar has been dealt with; the mercenaries leave for the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth and the miners go back to Sanuarach Mine

choices.choice: Side with the Silver-Bloods: get Ainethach to sell the mine
choices.leadsTo: tell Atar that Ainethach has been dealt with
